title: Worker
description: The information about an On-premise VP worker.

configurationDetails.description: Configuration details of the On-premise VP worker.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

displayName.description: Unique On-premise VP worker name that cannot be edited. The name should not contain any confidential information.

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type or scope. Exists for cross-compatibility only.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

geoInfo.description: Geographical information of the On-premise VP worker.

id.description: The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the On-premise VP worker.

monitorList.description: Monitors list assigned to the On-premise VP worker.

name.description: Unique permanent name of the On-premise VP worker. This is the same as the displayName.

opvpId.description: The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the On-premise vantage point.

priority.description: Priority of the On-premise VP worker to schedule monitors.

runtimeId.description: The runtime assigned id of the On-premise VP worker.

status.description: Enables or disables the On-premise VP worker.

timeCreated.description:
The time the resource was created, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339)
timestamp format.
Example: `2020-02-12T22:47:12.613Z`

timeLastSyncUp.description:
The time the resource was last synced, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339)
timestamp format.
Example: `2020-02-12T22:47:12.613Z`

timeUpdated.description:
The time the resource was updated, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339)
timestamp format.
Example: `2020-02-13T22:47:12.613Z`

workerType.description: Type of the On-premise VP worker.

IdentityInfoDetails.description: Domain details of the On-premise VP worker.

apmShortId.description: Domain short id of the On-premise VP worker.

collectorEndPoint.description: Collector endpoint of the On-premise VP worker.

regionName.description: Domain region of the On-premise VP worker.

OnPremiseVpWorkerVersionDetails.description: Image version details of the On-premise VP worker.

latestVersion.description: Latest image version of the On-premise VP worker.

minSupportedVersion.description: Minimum supported image version of the On-premise VP worker.

version.description: Current image version of the On-premise VP worker.

WorkerMonitorList.description: Details of the monitor assigned to an On-premise vantage point worker.

displayName.description: Unique name that can be edited. The name should not contain any confidential information.

isRunNow.description: If isRunNow is enabled, then the monitor will run immediately.

timeAssigned.description:
The time the resource was last assigned to an On-premise vantage point worker, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339)
timestamp format.
Example: `2020-02-12T22:47:12.613Z`
